description: It reads the teleprompter of one webinar: whether the prompter is switched on for this install, the script the host reads out loud together with its trigger lines, and the language the script is written in. Take it when a host wants to know whether a script exists, wants to read it again, or wants a new one written. "Is there already a script I can read from?" It needs the webinar id. It only reads and changes nothing. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: teleprompter, script, prompter on, trigger lines

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_get_webinar_prompter
title: Read the teleprompter script
